label: rem:q-navier-stokes-archimedean
title: Archimedean realisation of the $q$-Navier--Stokes system under the fibre functor
html:
Archimedean realisation. Following the categorical--archimedean bridge, the fibre functor \tau maps the categorical q-Navier--Stokes system to coordinates on the state bundle \mathcal{S}:

  \partial_t v + (v \cdot \nabla_A)v
  = 
  -\frac{1}{\rho}\nabla_A p
  -  \nabla_A Q_q
  +  \nu_q\Delta_q v
  +  \frac{1}{\rho}
  \nabla_A \cdot \boldsymbol{\sigma}_q,

where \nabla_A is the \mathrm{SU}(2) covariant derivative, and the coordinates of the q-deformed viscous stress tensor are

  (\boldsymbol{\sigma}_q)_{ij}
  = 
  \nu_q\rho
  \bigl(
    \nabla_{A,i}v_j + \nabla_{A,j}v_i
    - \tfrac{2}{3}(\nabla_A \cdot v)\delta_{ij}
  \bigr),

joined by the continuity equation \partial_t\rho + \nabla_A \cdot (\rho v) = 0.
heading: Remark
